known_issue: peak_memory_gb values in this sweep are likely inflated by leftover CUDA-allocator/torch.compile (dynamo) state from the torch_compile variant that ran immediately before this one in the same process (gc.collect()+empty_cache() does not clear torch._dynamo's compiled-artifact cache). Latency and throughput numbers are unaffected (monotonic, low run-to-run stdev) and are trustworthy; the absolute peak-memory figures here are not and should not be quoted as true per-batch-size memory cost.
